author: MarioNawfal
text:
🇾🇪 DID YOU KNOW that it’s estimated nearly 70 percent of adult males in Yemen are addicted to chewing a plant called khat? 

A farmer in a Yemeni khat field shows how a prune brings new shoots ready to pick in about 20 days. They pack those tender tips into their cheeks and chew them for hours.

Cathinone in the fresh leaves is the draw... causing a stimulant or narcotic-type sensation. World Bank researchers call it addictive chewing behavior.

Dependence screens find nearly half of male users meet clinical criteria. The crop already takes a large share of Yemen’s irrigation water and farmland that could grow food.

It pays better than grain, so the habit keeps the fields expanding.

Yet people wonder why poverty is so bad there.

Writer: Jamie  https://x.com/slmhktn/status/2100576747280371894/video/1
